title: The distributed intelligence spectrum
caption: Five-position continuum spanning nine orders of magnitude of power, with the TinyML, edge, and cloud spans marked. Our tier-ladder.svg redraws the same tiers as a constraint ladder (power x memory).

title: Fifty years of microprocessor trends
caption: Transistors keep rising past ~2005 while frequency and typical power plateau and cores take over: the end of Dennard scaling in one scatter (data: rupp2022microprocessor).

title: Memory-wall divergence
caption: Compute growth pulling away from memory-bandwidth growth; the same ~1.33x ratio our memory-wall chart compounds over a decade.

title: The screen-then-cost chain
caption: Privacy, latency, resource, cost in that order, each check excluding candidates before the next runs. Our screen-funnel.svg draws the same filters as a funnel with the cost of checking on the right.

title: Smart doorbell feasibility scorecard
caption: Demand/supply per constraint for the responsive chime: latency demand is 202% of supply (fails), flash only 11.9% (passes). The two-level screen as a bar plot.
